text:
emma-sales: Urgent escalation from Kestrel Health execs. They need two firm answers before CTL signs: (1) a confirmed discount for a 24mo reserved commit, (2) evidence we can guarantee EU-only processing + KMS with audit trails. Their POC soak shows inconsistent throughput vs demo (they expect ~10k tokens/s sustained).
raj-se: I replayed their workload. Hotspot is kv-cache churn during multi-turn dialogs. Short log: 
`2026-07-11T10:14:02Z worker-4 WARN kv_eviction shard=7 free=90MB`
`2026-07-11T10:14:03Z worker-4 INFO throughput=8800 tokens/s seq=4096`
oliver-eng: Quick mitigation: increase kv-shards, pin model quantization q5b, and run on dedicated pool. Command: `redwood deploy --env kestrel-demo --region eu-west-2 --pool-size 5 --kv-shards 20 --model q5b/redwood-prod`
ops-bot: deployment kestrel-demo requested by oliver-eng at 2026-07-11T10:20:11Z  job id fa12. Est ready ~35m.
oliver-eng: Initial 40m soak: sustained 10.1k tokens/s, p50=21ms, p95=180ms, kv_miss=3.6%. No OOMs. Uploading artifacts.
raj-se: I'll produce a reproducible gist with exact redwood CLI and knobs for the customer.
tess-gtm: Pricing ask: Kestrel asked for 28% off list for 24mo. That's outside standard band. Can we consider a stepped concession?
marta-legal: 28% requires exec sign-off. Recommend counter: 18% with 6mo non-refundable minimum and annual true-up. Also drafting data residency + KMS clause; customer wants 7yr audit retention and export to their SIEM.
noah-cto: EU-only guarantee requires either Dedicated tenancy in eu-west-2 or Private deployment with customer VPC. Ops surcharge applies. Also for KMS we can do BYOK via our KMS integration; pen-test and SOC2 artifacts available but customer-specific pen-test will need coordination.
emma-sales: Action items: - oliver-eng: post perf report + artifacts (ETA 1h) - raj-se: publish repro gist (ETA 45m) - marta-legal: draft pricing redline + residency/KMS clause (ETA EOD) - noah-cto: ops surcharge estimate and timeline (ETA EOD) - tess-gtm: exec one-pager with pricing bands and conseq (ETA EOD)
tess-gtm: If legal accepts 18% + non-refundable ramp, can we ask for a 30% commit floor? Any objections?
marta-legal: OK if we get a firm usage floor and a short notice period. I'll pen the clause.
emma-sales: Thanks team  goal is to have the one-pager and legal redline today so AE can schedule signature call tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: reminder: presales triage call for Kestrel Health at 2026-07-11T11:30:00Z -> https://meet.redwood/kestrel-presales-15m
